model.title: To amend the Mineral Leasing Act for Acquired Lands to make that Act applicable to hardrock minerals.
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee, Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Pat Fallon (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would expand federal land availability for hardrock mineral mining by making the Mineral Leasing Act for Acquired Lands apply to hardrock minerals like metals and gemstones. Currently, hardrock minerals can only be leased on certain federally acquired lands, while other minerals like coal and oil are already eligible for leasing across a broader range of federal property.
